annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: New stash-forge CLI loads stash.config.ts with jiti 2.6.1 `createJiti(path,{interopDefault:true})` + `jiti.import()`; in jiti 2 the constructor option does not apply to import(), so the module namespace `{default:{...}}` is validated and fails ('databaseUrl: received undefined').

known_defects.description: Config loader does not unwrap the default export; valid configs fail validation
known_defects.mechanism: jiti.import ignores constructor interopDefault in jiti 2.x
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario says config loading may return the module namespace / not unwrap the default export (or that the jiti interop option does not apply), so a valid config fails validation.
